blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: An agent's memory must remain useful as information changes across conversations. A new fact may replace an earlier value without making that value irrelevant to a later question. We present Temporal State Tracking Memory (TEM), a training-free framework for tracking these changes. TEM stores facts as versioned records linked to their sources. It retrieves relevant versions, places them in source order and labels historical records before passing the evidence to the answer model. Event memory and original dialogue turns provide details missing from structured facts. We evaluated TEM on 420 questions drawn from 600 sessions involving 60 personas. Across four open-weight models, key-entity hit rates reached 75.71-97.62% overall and 96.67-100.00% on the historical-residence subset. Adding historical labels to otherwise identical, source-ordered facts increased overall hit rates by 17.14-55.95 percentage points. The evidence was compact: 94-118 tokens per answer, or 48.75-56.73% less than session-aware retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). A further evaluation on 1,540 LoCoMo questions tested hybrid memory under a fixed evidence budget. TEM exceeded session-aware RAG with both backbones; conservative score differences were 7.92 and 10.58 percentage points. The results support preserving fact versions and exposing their temporal status to the generator when answering questions about repeatedly updated information.
blocks.zh: 随着对话中信息的变化,经纪人的记忆必须保持有用。 新的事实可能取代早先的数值,而不使该数值与以后的问题无关。 我们提出《国家追踪记忆》,这是跟踪这些变化的无培训框架。 TEM将事实存储为与其来源相关的版本记录. 它检索出相关版本,将它们按出处顺序排列并给历史记录贴上标签,然后将证据传递给答案模型. 事件记忆和原始对话转弯提供了结构化事实中缺失的细节. 我们评价了TEM对来自600场会议、涉及60人的420个问题的评价。 在四种开放重量模式中,关键实体的命中率总体达到75.71-97.62%,历史居住子集的命中率达到96.67%-100.0%。 将历史标签加进原本相同的、源头命令的事实,使整体打击率提高了17.14-55.95个百分点。 证据是紧凑的:每回94-118个令牌,或48.75-56.73%,比会话感知回取增强生成(RAG)少. 进一步评价了1,540个LoCoMo问题,在固定的证据预算下测试了混合内存. TEM以双主干超越了会话意识RAG;保守得分差异为7.92分和10.58分. 结果支持保留事实版本,并在回答关于反复更新信息的问题时向生成者披露其时间状态.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: A long-term agent accumulates records that may no longer describe its user. Residence, occupation, employer and preferences can change several times across sessions Zhang et al. (2025) ; Hu et al. (2025) ; Wang et al. (2024) . Earlier records still matter when a question refers to the past. The agent therefore needs to know which version applies to the question, including whether the latest record is relevant at all.
blocks.zh: 长期代理会积累可能不再描述其用户的记录. 居住、职业、雇主和偏好可在各届间发生几次变化。 张等 (2025年); 胡等 (2025年); 王等 (2024年). 以前的记录在问题提到过去时仍然很重要。 因此,代理人需要知道哪一种版本适用于这个问题,包括最新记录是否完全相关.

blocks.en: Suppose a user moves from Shanghai to Chengdu and then to Suzhou. Suzhou answers “Where does the user live now?” The question “Where did the user live before moving to Chengdu?” requires Shanghai. A memory that keeps only the latest address cannot answer both. Keeping all three addresses makes the historical answer available, but the model still has to identify the right one.
blocks.zh: 假设一个用户从上海搬去成都再搬去苏州. 苏州回答 “用户现在住在哪里?” “在迁入成都之前,用户住在哪里?” 只保留最新地址的内存无法同时回答两者. 保留这三处地址可以提供历史答案,但模型仍然必须确定正确的答案.

blocks.en: Persistent memory, action feedback and experience-based reflection have extended agents’ use of past interactions Park et al. (2023) ; Yao et al. (2022) ; Shinn et al. (2023) . Work on hierarchical storage, memory updates, associative retrieval and temporal graphs has also improved access to this information Packer et al. (2023) ; Zhong et al. (2024) ; Wang et al. (2023) ; Xu et al. (2025) ; Chhikara et al. (2025) ; Kang et al. (2025) ; Rasmussen et al. (2025) ; Fang et al. (2025) . Repeated updates pose a particular problem: several retrieved values may be equally relevant to a question yet refer to different states. We examine how the memory can convey these version relationships to the answering model.
blocks.zh: 持续的记忆、行动反馈和以经验为基础的反思扩大了以往相互作用Park等人(2023年)、姚等人(2022年)、Shinn等人(2023年)的使用范围。 关于分级存储,内存更新,关联检索和时间图的工作也改善了获取此信息Packer等(2023年); Zh等(2024年);王等(2023年);徐等(2025年);克希卡拉等(2025年);克干等(2025年);拉斯穆森等(2025年);方克等(2025年). 重复更新造成一个特殊问题:若干检索到的值可能与一个问题同样相关,但涉及不同的状态。 我们研究内存如何将这些版本关系传达给解答模式.

blocks.en: TEM records cross-session changes as fact versions without retraining the backbone. New facts are appended, and the status of earlier records is updated from their source order. At query time, relevance scores select the evidence. TEM then orders the selected facts by source and labels historical versions. This separates evidence selection from the presentation of temporal information. Event memory and original turns supply details that the fact records do not capture.
blocks.zh: TEM将跨会场变化记录为事实版本而无需再培训骨干. 附上了新的事实,并更新了以前记录的原始记录。 在查询时间,相关评分会选择证据. TEM随后按来源命令选定事实,并给历史版本贴上标签. 这把证据选择与提供时间信息分开。 事件内存和原始转弯 提供细节 事实记录不捕捉。

blocks.en: Our contribution is a history-preserving update rule that assigns state over complete fact-version groups. The evidence construction procedure carries this status into retrieval output, so an older record stays historical when the latest version is not retrieved. We evaluate both components across multiple backbones and examine hybrid memory on public multi-session questions.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是一个保存历史的更新规则,它指定状态超过完整的事实转换组. 证据构建程序将这种状态带入检索输出中,因此,当最新版本没有被检索时,一个更古老的记录仍为历史. 我们评价两个组成部分跨多个骨干,并审查公共多会题上的混合记忆。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Long-Term Agent Memory and Structured Organisation
blocks.zh: 2.1 长期代理内存和结构化组织

blocks.en: External memory lets an agent read and write information outside its model parameters. Hierarchical management in MemGPT and the historical storage mechanisms studied in MemoryBank and long-term memory augmentation provide ways to retain information beyond the immediate context Packer et al. (2023) ; Zhong et al. (2024) ; Wang et al. (2023) . A-MEM, Mem0 and MemoryOS extend this work through memory associations, updates and hierarchical organisation Xu et al. (2025) ; Chhikara et al. (2025) ; Kang et al. (2025) . Temporal information enters the memory itself in Zep’s knowledge graph Rasmussen et al. (2025) , making it particularly relevant to state tracking. TEM examines how version status is carried from stored records into answer evidence. Memory processing cost is another concern; LightMem addresses it through staged operations Fang et al. (2025) .
blocks.zh: 外部内存允许一个代理在其模型参数外读取并写入信息. MemGPT中的分级管理以及记忆银行和长期记忆增强中研究的历史存储机制,提供了将信息保留到直接上下文之外的方法Packer等(2023年);Zhong等(2024年);Wang等(2023年). A-MEM,Mem0和记忆. OS通过记忆协会、更新和等级组织Xu等人(2025年);Chhikara等人(2025年);Kang等人(2025年)扩展了这项工作。 Temperal information在Zep的知识图Rasmussen等人(2025年)中输入了记忆本身,使其与状态跟踪特别相关. TEM检查版本状态如何从所存储的记录中传入答案证据. 内存处理成本是另一个问题; LightMem 通过分阶段操作解决它 Fang等 (2025) (英语).

blocks.en: Graph-based retrieval connects information spread across records. Associative retrieval is central to HippoRAG and its successor, while GraphRAG uses graph organisation for query-focused summarisation Gutiérrez et al. (2024) ; Gutiérrez et al. (2025) ; Edge et al. (2024) . Beyond these retrieval structures, MemoRAG uses global memory to guide evidence access, and MemOS considers knowledge access across the memory lifecycle Qian et al. (2024) ; Li et al. (2025) .
blocks.zh: 基于图表的检索将分散在记录中的信息连接起来。 联合检索是HippoRAG及其继任者的核心,而GraphRAG则使用图表组织来集中查询Gutiérrez等人(2024);Gutiérrez等人(2025);Edge等人(2024)。 除了这些检索结构外,MemoRAG还使用全球内存来指导证据的取用,MemoOS考虑整个内存生命周期的知识取用Qian等 (2024).; Li等 (2025).

blocks.en: KG-RAG combines knowledge-graph retrieval and question decomposition for multi-hop question answering without additional training Linders and Tomczak (2025) . CTRN addresses complex time constraints through implicit temporal and relational representations Jiao et al. (2023) . MGIT models temporal dependencies at multiple granularities Fang et al. (2026) . These graph-based question-answering methods are relevant to TEM’s use of structured evidence. Our focus is the management of fact versions as conversations update a state, including how the resulting status information reaches the generator.
blocks.zh: KG-RAG结合了知识-图回取和问题分解,用于多跳问题解答,而无需额外训练Linders和Tomczak(2025). CTRN通过隐含的时间和关系表述来解决复杂的时间限制问题. Jiao等 (2023). MGIT模型在多颗粒Fang等地的时间依赖性(2026). 这些以图表为基础的问答方法与TEM使用结构化证据有关. 我们的重点是在对话更新状态时管理事实版本,包括由此产生的状态信息如何到达生成器。

blocks.en: 2.2 Long-Term Memory Evaluation and Retrieval Augmentation
blocks.zh: 2.2 长期记忆评估和检索增强

blocks.en: LongMemEval and LoCoMo evaluate cross-session information use, fact updates and temporal reasoning Wu et al. (2024) ; Maharana et al. (2024) . LongBench covers a broader set of long-context tasks Bai et al. (2024) . Lost in the Middle shows that the position of relevant information can affect model performance Liu et al. (2024) . For state tracking, finding a relevant passage does not settle which version answers the question. We study this choice in controlled update tasks and evaluate hybrid retrieval on public multi-session questions.
blocks.zh: LongMemEval和LoCoMo评价跨会信息使用,事实更新和时间推理 Wu等 (2024); Maharana等 (2024). Long Bench 涵盖了一套更广泛的长文任务 Bai et al. (2024). 迷失于"中"显示相关信息的位置会影响模型性能 刘等 (2024). 对于状态跟踪,找到相关段落并不能解决哪个版本回答了问题. 我们在可控更新任务中研究这一选择,并评价公共多会场问题的混合检索.

blocks.en: RAG and dense retrieval provide the basis for accessing external evidence Lewis et al. (2020) ; Karpukhin et al. (2020) . Self-RAG evaluates evidence, RAPTOR organises it hierarchically, and interleaved retrieval supports chain-of-thought reasoning Asai et al. (2023) ; Sarthi et al. (2024) ; Trivedi et al. (2023) . LLMLingua, LongLLMLingua and RECOMP reduce the input passed to the generator Jiang et al. (2023) ; Jiang et al. (2024) ; Xu et al. (2023) . TEM retains version order and state attributes alongside retrieved facts, allowing the generator to interpret the selected evidence in its temporal context.
blocks.zh: RAG和密集检索为获取外部证据提供了依据Lewis等人(2020年);Karpukhin等人(2020年). Self-RAG评价证据,RAPTOR按等级组织,并互放回取支持思维链推理 Asai等 (2023); Sarthi等 (2024); Trivedi等 (2023). LLMLingua, LongLLMLingua和RECOMP减少传递给发电机Jiang等的输入(2023);Jiang等(2024);Xu等(2023). TEM保留了版本顺序并和被检索的事实一起状态属性,使生成器能够在其时间上下文中解释所选证据.

blocks.en: 3 Temporal State Tracking Memory
blocks.zh: 3 临时状态跟踪记忆

blocks.en: TEM stores each fact with its provenance and places successive values in a version group. Source order determines the status of each version. Retrieval then selects the facts to include in the answer evidence. Figure 1 gives the overall framework; Fig. 2 and Algorithm 1 detail the update and retrieval procedure.
blocks.zh: TEM 存储着每个事实的出处,并将相继的值放在一个版本组中. 源指令决定了每个版本的状态. 然后检索,选择将事实纳入答案证据。 图1给出了总体框架;图2和算法1详细介绍了更新和检索程序.

blocks.en: Figure 1: TEM framework. Fact versions are linked to source sessions. Retrieved facts appear in source order, with historical labels on superseded versions. Dashed connections supply event and original-text evidence.
blocks.zh: 图1:TEM框架。 事实版本与源会话相链接. 已获取的事实以源顺序出现,在被取代的版本上有历史标签. 默认连接提供事件和正本证据 。

blocks.en: 3.1 Fact Versions with Provenance
blocks.zh: 3.1 有证据的事实版本

blocks.en: A fact record contains the subject, relation, object, source session and source index. Records with the same subject and relation belong to one version group:
blocks.zh: 事实记录包含主题,关系,对象,源会话和源索引. 具有相同主题和关系的记录属于一个版本组:

blocks.en: f = ( s , r , o , σ , τ ) , g ⁡ ( f ) = ( norm ⁡ ( s ) , r ) f=(s,r,o,\sigma,\tau),\qquad g(f)=(\operatorname{norm}(s),r) (1)
blocks.zh: f= (s, r, o, σ, σ), g= (规范为 ⁡ (s), r, r= (s, o, sigma,\tau),\qquad g(f)= (\operatorname{norm} (s), r) (1) 国家

blocks.en: The source session identifies the original record. Its index determines the position of that record in the version sequence. We group records by subject and relation, normalising subject names to lowercase. Excluding the object from the key lets different values of a relation remain in the same group.
blocks.zh: 源会话识别出原始记录. 它的索引决定了该记录在版本序列中的位置. 我们按主题和关系来分类记录,将主题名称规范为小写. 将对象从密钥中排除后,关系的不同值仍保留在同一组中。

blocks.en: An update changes a record’s status but leaves its value and provenance intact. The rule assumes single-valued updates arriving in session order. Source indices record when information entered the memory; they do not establish when the underlying event took effect.
blocks.zh: 更新会改变记录的状况, 该规则假设单值更新按会话顺序到达. 源索引记录信息输入内存时;它们没有确定基本事件何时生效.

blocks.en: 3.2 History-Preserving Incremental Updates
blocks.zh: 3.2 保留历史的递增更新

blocks.en: TEM appends facts from each new session to the existing version set without overwriting earlier values (Fig. 2a):
blocks.zh: TEM 将每个新会话中的事实附加到现有的版本中, 不覆盖先前的值( 图 2a) :

blocks.en: A frozen model extracts facts from the new session. TEM checks their format and consistency with the source text before attaching the session provenance.
blocks.zh: 一个被冻结的模型从新的会话中提取事实. TEM 在附加会话出处之前检查它们的格式和与源文本的一致性 。

blocks.en: TEM determines status from the complete version group before selecting evidence. A version is historical if its source index is smaller than the maximum index in that subject–relation group:
blocks.zh: TEM 在选择证据前先从完整版本组确定状态. 如果一个版本的源索引小于该主题-关系组中的最大索引,则该版本具有历史意义:

The historical attribute is one for a superseded version and zero when no later source exists. Both the value and its provenance remain in memory. A missed retrieval of the latest version therefore cannot make an older record appear current.
blocks.zh: 历史属性为被取代的版本的属性为一,而后源不存在时为零. 价值及其出处都留在记忆中。 因此,对最新版本的检索缺失,无法使更古老的记录显得具有时事性。

blocks.en: The label identifies a record as historical; its source index places it among the earlier versions. All records at the maximum source index are treated as current. This rule leaves conflicting values within the same session unresolved.
blocks.zh: 标签将记录确定为历史;其出处索引将其置于更早的版本中. 最大源指数上的所有记录都作为电流处理. 这一规则使同一会话中相互冲突的价值观得不到解决。

blocks.en: 3.3 Relevance Retrieval and Temporal Evidence
blocks.zh: 3.3 相关性检索和临时证据

blocks.en: Retrieval selects facts by relevance without penalising older versions for their age. TEM then places the selected facts in source order (Fig. 2b). The query, source order and version status are available to the generator when it chooses an answer.
blocks.zh: 检索根据相关性选择事实,而不惩罚年龄较大的版本。 TEM然后将所选事实按出处顺序排列(图2b). 当生成器选择一个答案时,其查询,源顺序和版本状态可供使用.

blocks.en: Candidate scores combine similarity from the shared vector retriever with a weight for the relation type:
blocks.zh: 候选人的分数结合了共享向量检索器的相似性与关系类型的权重:

blocks.en: The relation weights are 1.0 for residence and employer, 0.9 for occupation, 0.8 for possession, and 0.6 for likes and dislikes. We apply this scoring rule to all versions and retrieve at most 15, taking those with the highest scores.
blocks.zh: 关系权重为:居住和雇主为1.0;职业为0.9;拥有为0.8;喜欢和不喜欢为0.6。 我们把这个评分规则应用到所有版本中,并最多检索到15个版本,取出得分最高的版本.

blocks.en: TEM sorts the selected records by ascending source index, keeping the fact content and source session. Superseded versions receive a [historical] label. The latest version has no label. Evidence construction and answering follow:
blocks.zh: TEM 按上行源索引排序选中的记录, 保留事实内容和源会话 。 被取而代之的版本获得一个[历史]标签. 最新版本没有标签. 证据构建和答复如下:

The retrieval budget counts fact records. Sorting and labelling leave their values unchanged. TEM does not use the question to exclude current or historical versions in advance; the generator chooses among the retrieved versions using the query and the supplied temporal information.
blocks.zh: 检索预算计算出事实记录。 排序和标签使其数值保持不变。 TEM不使用这个问题预先排除当前版本或历史版本;生成器使用查询和提供的时间信息在被检索版本中选择.

blocks.en: 3.4 Update and Evidence Construction Algorithm
blocks.zh: 3.4 更新和证据构建算法

blocks.en: Algorithm 1 specifies version updates and retrieval, using frozen models for fact extraction and answer generation.
blocks.zh: 算法 1 指定了版本更新和检索,使用被冻结的模型来进行事实提取和解答生成.

blocks.en: Algorithm 1 Fact-version updates and temporal evidence construction
blocks.zh: 算法 1 事实版本更新和时间证据构建

blocks.en: AttachSource links each fact to its source session and index.
blocks.zh: 附加来源链接每个事实到它的源会话和索引.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Fact-version updates and evidence construction. a, Appending a new version updates the status of retained records. b, Retrieval selects relevant facts, which are then ordered by source and labelled if historical. Symbols v and s denote a fact version and its source session.
blocks.zh: 图2:事实版本更新和证据构建。 a 包括: 提供新版本更新保留记录的状况。 b,检索选择相关事实,然后由来源命令,如果是历史,则贴上标签。 符号 v 和 s 表示一个事实版本及其出处会话。

blocks.en: 3.5 Event Memory and Original-Text Evidence
blocks.zh: 3.5 事件记忆和原始文本证据

blocks.en: Some information does not fit a structured fact value, including event context and conditions on behaviour. TEM stores event summaries, free-text memories and original turns for this purpose. Source-session links connect these records to fact versions. Hybrid retrieval draws on both sources of evidence.
blocks.zh: 一些信息不符合结构化的事实价值,包括事件背景和行为条件. TEM为此存储了事件摘要,自由文本记忆和原始转会. 源会话链接将这些记录与事实版本相连接. 混合检索利用了两种证据来源。

blocks.en: We use the fact-memory configuration TEM-Status for state-update experiments and TEM-Hybrid-State for public question answering. The hybrid configuration combines the evidence sources under a common budget. Its unmarked control uses the same candidates in the same order (Sections 4.1 and 4.6).
blocks.zh: 我们使用事实-记忆配置 TEM- status 用于状态更新实验, TEM-Hybrid-State 用于公开回答问题. 混合配置在共同预算下结合了证据来源. 它的无标记控制以同样的顺序使用同样的候选人(第4.1和4.6节)。

blocks.en: 4 Experiments and Results
blocks.zh: 4 实验和结果

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: The state-update benchmark contains 60 personas, 600 sessions and 420 questions involving residence, occupation and drinks. There are 180 current-state questions, 180 other historical questions and 60 questions about residence immediately before the latest move. For a historical question, the reference answer is the most recent applicable fact before the target update. Running six memory configurations with four backbones produced 10,080 answers.
blocks.zh: 国家更新基准包括60人、600个课和420个涉及居住、职业和饮料的问题。 有180个当前状态问题,180个其他历史问题,以及60个关于最近搬迁前的居住问题. 对于一个历史问题,参考答案是目标更新前的最新适用事实. 运行有4个主干线的6个内存配置,产生了10,080个答案.

blocks.en: We compared TEM with naive RAG, session-aware RAG and full context. Session-aware RAG keeps retrieved source turns in session order. The fact-memory comparison uses three configurations. Overwrite keeps only the latest version. Unmarked keeps all versions in source order, and TEM-Status adds historical labels to the same content without changing that order.
blocks.zh: 我们把TEM比作天真的RAG, 了解会话的RAG和全面的背景。 有会话意识的RAG按会话顺序保持被检索源回转. 事实-记忆比较采用三种配置. 覆盖仅保留最新版本 。 未标记保留了所有版本的源顺序,而TEM-Status在不改变该顺序的情况下将历史标签添加到相同内容.

blocks.en: Experiments used an A100 40 GB GPU. Extraction and answering within a configuration used the same frozen backbone. We retrieved at most 15 candidates with all-mpnet-base-v2 and set temperature to zero and the random seed to 42. Llama and Qwen ran in BF16 with a 512-token answer limit; Qwen thinking was disabled. For gpt-oss, we used MXFP4, low reasoning effort and a 4,096-token answer limit. All backbones had an 8,192-token extraction output limit.
blocks.zh: 实验使用了A100 40 GB GPU. 在一个配置中提取和答复使用了相同的被冻结的骨干。 我们找到最多15个候选者 和全通网基V2 并设定温度为零,随机种子为42。 Llama和Quen在BF16中跑出512个托肯答题限制;Quen思维被禁用. 对于gpt-oss,我们使用了MXFP4,低推理努力和4,096-token的回答极限. 所有骨干都有8 192个抽取输出限制。

blocks.en: We measured state-update performance by key-entity hit rate, counting an answer as a hit if it contained the reference entity under case-insensitive matching. Public question answering used strict semantic scoring, which required the answer to satisfy both factual and temporal conditions.
blocks.zh: 我们用按键实体的命中率测量了状态更新的性能,将一个答案算作命中,如果它包含在对大小写不敏感比对下的参考实体的话. 公开问答使用严格的语义评分,这需要答案来满足事实和时间条件.

blocks.en: 4.2 Overall Question Answering
blocks.zh: 4.2 总的回答问题

blocks.en: With fact content and source order held constant, TEM-Status improved overall key-entity hit rates by 17.14–55.95 percentage points over Unmarked across the four backbones (Table 1).
blocks.zh: 由于事实内容和源头顺序保持不变,TEM-现状使总体关键实体受冲击率比四个主干单位的未标值高出17.14-55.95个百分点(表1)。

blocks.en: Table 1: Effect of historical labels on overall key-entity hit rate
blocks.zh: 表1:历史标签对整体关键实体命中率的影响

blocks.en: TEM-Status achieved overall key-entity hit rates of 75.71–97.62%, exceeding session-aware RAG by 1.43–40.00 percentage points and full context by 2.14–30.24 points (Table 2).
blocks.zh: TEM-现状实现了75.71-97.62%的总关键实体命中率,超过会话的RAG1.43-40.00个百分点,全上下文2.14-30.24个百分点(表2)。

blocks.en: Table 2: Overall key-entity hit rates across four backbones and six configurations (%)
blocks.zh: 表2:四个骨干和六个配置的总体关键实体命中率(%)

blocks.en: 4.3 Historical States after Repeated Updates
blocks.zh: 4.3 重复更新后的历史国家

blocks.en: Overwrite recovered few historical residence values, with hit rates of 0–8.33%. Keeping earlier versions without labels raised the rates to 41.67–81.67%. TEM-Status reached 96.67–100.00% after historical labels were added to the same evidence (Fig. 3a).
blocks.zh: 覆盖回收的历史居住价值,点击率为0-8.33%。 保留先前的版本,没有标签,将费率提高到41.67-81.67%。 TEM-现状在历史标签被添加到同一证据后达到了96.67-100.0%(图3a)。

blocks.en: TEM-Status exceeded session-aware RAG by 10.00–88.33 percentage points and full context by 3.33–40.00 points (Table 3).
blocks.zh: TEM - status 超过会话感知RAG 10:00–88.33个百分点,完整上下文为3.33–40.00分(表3).

blocks.en: Figure 3: Effects of version retention and historical labels. a, Historical-residence hit rates (60 questions). b, Overall gains over Unmarked (420 questions). pp denotes percentage points.
blocks.zh: 图3:版本保留和历史标签的影响。 a. 历史居住率(60个问题)。 b. 比未标明事项的总收益(420个问题)。 pp表示百分点。

blocks.en: Table 3: Historical-residence retrieval after repeated updates (key-entity hit rate, %)
blocks.zh: 表3:经反复更新后的历史居住检索(关键实体命中率,%)

blocks.en: 4.4 Ablation of State Labels
blocks.zh: 4.4 国家标签的滥用

blocks.en: Adding historical labels gave 235 more hits with Llama-3.1-8B, 208 with Qwen3.5-4B, 72 with Qwen3.5-9B and 174 with gpt-oss-20b over 420 questions (Table 4). These counts measure the net change in hits with fact content and source order held fixed.
blocks.zh: 添加历史标签后,与Llama-3.1-8B的点击率又增加了235个,与Quen3.5-4B的点击率增加了208个,与Quen3.5-9B的点击率增加了72个,与gpt-oss-20b的点击率增加了174个,超过420个问题(表4)。 这些计数以事实内容和定出源顺序来衡量点击量的净变化。

blocks.en: Table 4: Overall hit counts with and without historical labels
blocks.zh: 表4:有历史标签和没有历史标签的总体打击数

blocks.en: The selected examples illustrate errors in identifying the time or relation requested by a question (Fig. 4). Under the control configurations, the same backbone sometimes used an old value as current, confused versions around an update or returned an unrelated relation. TEM recovered the requested value in each of these examples.
blocks.zh: 所选的例子说明了在识别一个问题所要求的时间或关系方面的错误(图4)。 在控制配置下,同一个骨干有时会使用一个旧值作为当前,混淆的版本围绕更新或者返回一个无关关系. TEM 在其中的每一个例子中恢复了所要求的值。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Selected successful corrections across backbones. Arrows show source-session order; bold states give the reference values. Check marks and crosses indicate correct and incorrect answers. The control configuration is identified in each panel. Panel c marks omitted text with […].
blocks.zh: 图 4: 跨骨干部分成功纠正。 箭头显示源片段顺序;粗体状态给出了引用值. 检查标记和交叉表示正确和不正确的答案。 每个面板中都确定了控制配置. c 面板标记省略了文本 。

blocks.en: Historical labels increased hit rates by 18.33–56.67 percentage points on the 60 residence questions (Table 5). The remaining 360 questions combine current-state and other historical queries. Gains of 16.94–55.83 points on this group show that the improvement extended beyond the historical-residence subset.
blocks.zh: 历史标签在60个居住问题上的点击率提高了18.33-56.67个百分点(表5)。 剩下的360个问题结合了当前状态和其他历史的查询. 这一组的16.94–55.83分的得分表明,这一改进超越了历史-居住子集.

blocks.en: Table 5: Key-entity hit rates and label gains by query group
blocks.zh: 表5:按查询组分列的按键实体的点击率和标签收益

blocks.en: 4.5 Answer-Evidence Length
blocks.zh: 4.5 答复证据长度

blocks.en: TEM used 94.05–117.55 tokens of answer evidence on average, 48.75–56.73% less than session-aware RAG (Table 6). These lengths exclude memory construction and embedding computation.
blocks.zh: TEM使用了94.05-117.55个答题证物,平均比有会话意识的RAG少了48.75-56.73%(表6)。 这些长度不包括内存构造和嵌入计算.

blocks.en: Figure 5: Answer-evidence length distributions, with 420 queries per configuration. Boxes show the interquartile range, centre lines the median, and whiskers the minimum and maximum.
blocks.zh: 图5 答案-证据长度分布,每个配置有420个查询. 方框显示相位范围、中线和胡须的最小和最大值。

blocks.en: Table 6: Mean evidence length during answering
blocks.zh: 表6:答复中的平均证据长度

blocks.en: TEM evidence ranged from 84 to 125 tokens across all queries (Fig. 5). Even the shortest inputs from session-aware RAG and full context were longer, at 202 and 165 tokens.
blocks.zh: 在所有查询中,TEM的证据从84到125个符号不等(图5)。 即使来自会议意识的RAG和全面背景的最短投入也更长,分别为202个和165个。

blocks.en: 4.6 Public Multi-Session Question Answering
blocks.zh: 4.6 公开的多场会议问答

blocks.en: We evaluated public question answering on 10 LoCoMo conversations containing 1,540 questions: 282 multi-hop, 321 temporal, 96 open-domain and 841 single-hop. Llama-3.1-8B and Qwen3.5-9B each ran four configurations, producing 12,320 answers in total. TEM-Hybrid-State, TEM-Hybrid-Unmarked and session-aware RAG shared a 1,024-token evidence limit. The two hybrid configurations used identical candidates and ordering. A long-context configuration provided a further reference. All memories were built from the source conversations only.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了10个LoCoMo对话中的公开问题回答,其中包含1,540个问题:282个多跳,321个时空,96个开放域和841个单跳. 拉玛-3.1-8B和Quen3.5-9B 每个都运行了四个配置,总共产生12,320个答案. TEM-Hybrid-State、TEM-Hybrid-Unmarked和会话意识的RAG共用了1,024个托肯证据限额。 两个混合组合使用了相同的候选并订购. 长文配置提供了进一步参考。 所有记忆都是只从源头对话中建立起来的.

blocks.en: For each backbone, we kept the answer prompt, zero temperature, seed 42 and 1,024-token answer limit fixed across configurations. Qwen thinking was disabled. Inputs to the long-context reference were truncated at the 32,768-token model window; this affected 1,151 questions per backbone. We used gpt-oss-20b to score factual and temporal correctness against the reference answers and supporting turns.
blocks.zh: 每根骨干,我们保持了答题的快速,零温度,种子42和1,024-token的答题限制在组合上固定. Quen的思维被禁用. 在32,768个托肯模型窗口上,对长文引用的输入被截取;这影响到每个主干线的1,151个问题。 我们用gpt-oss-20b来比照参考答案和辅助转折来评分事实和时间正确性。

blocks.en: Ambiguity in the reference information left 216 answers unresolved. We retained the full question count as the denominator and assigned these cases zero or one to obtain score bounds. Eleven truncated or empty answers counted as incorrect.
blocks.zh: 参考信息中含糊不清,有216个答案未解决. 我们保留了完整的问题计数作为分母,并指定这些案件为0或1来获得分数界限. 11个简短或空的答案被计算为不正确 。

blocks.en: Under the same retrieval budget, Llama scored 27.53–29.22% with TEM and 17.92–19.61% with session-aware RAG (Table 7). Qwen scored 35.84–37.53% and 23.70–25.26%, respectively. Even subtracting the RAG upper bound from the TEM lower bound left gaps of 7.92 and 10.58 percentage points.
blocks.zh: 根据同样的检索预算,Llama的得分是27.53-29.22%的TEM,17.92-19.61%的得分是知会RAG(表7)。 Quen的得分分别为35.84–37.53%和23.70–25.26%. 即使从TEM下限中减去RAG上限,左差为7.92和10.58个百分点.

blocks.en: Table 7: Strict semantic scores on LoCoMo for two backbones (%)
blocks.zh: 表7:两个骨干在LoCoMo上的严格语义分数(%)

blocks.en: Historical labels made little difference to overall LoCoMo scores. Mean TEM evidence lengths were 1,014.6 tokens for Llama and 1,017.5 for Qwen, close to session-aware RAG. The long-context reference scored higher with much larger inputs: 29,671.8 and 30,412.9 tokens, respectively. These public questions require event details and multi-hop associations as well as state information. The similar scores of the marked and unmarked variants suggest that hybrid evidence organisation accounts for most of the observed gain over RAG.
blocks.zh: 历史标签对于LoCoMo的整体分数没有什么区别. 平均TEM证据长度为:Llama1,014.6个令牌;Quen1,017.5个令牌,接近会话意识RAG. 长文参考得分较高,投入大得多:分别为29,671.8和30,412.9个令牌. 这些公共问题需要活动细节和多跳协会以及国家信息。 标记的和无标记的变体的相类似分数表明,混合证据组织占了所观察到的超过RAG的大部分收益。

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: The state-update results separate two requirements of historical question answering. A memory must first keep earlier values accessible. Once those values are available, the generator still needs to identify which one applies. In the ablation, historical labels improved hit rates without changing the facts or their source order. Retrieval therefore did not account for the difference between the two configurations. The result supports treating version status as part of the evidence presented to the generator, even when it can in principle be inferred from the ordered records.
blocks.zh: 状态更新的结果将历史问答的两个要求分开. 一个内存必须首先保持较早的值的可访问性. 一旦有了这些数值,生成器仍需要确定适用哪个数值。 在通俗化中,历史标签在不改变事实或源头顺序的情况下提高了命中率. 因此,检索没有说明两种配置的差异。 其结果支持将版本状态作为提交生成者的证据的一部分,即使原则上可以从命令的记录中推断出来。

blocks.en: On LoCoMo, marked and unmarked hybrid memory obtained similar scores, and both exceeded session-aware RAG under the same evidence budget. The contrast with the state-update task helps define the role of the labels. They directly indicate whether a retained value has been superseded, but do not supply missing event details or cross-session associations. These are also needed for public dialogue questions. The hybrid-memory gain on LoCoMo is therefore better understood at the level of evidence organisation, without attributing it to historical labels alone.
blocks.zh: 在"LoCoMo"上,有标记和无标记的混合内存获得了相类似的分数,两者在相同的证据预算下都超过了会话意识RAG. 与状态更新任务对比有助于定义标签的作用. 它们直接表明保留价值是否已被取代,但不提供缺失事件细节或跨会协会。 公开对话问题也需要这些内容。 因此,在证据组织一级对LoCoMo的混合模型收益有更好的了解,而不只是将其归因于历史标签。

blocks.en: TEM uses source-session order to assign state, assuming explicit single-valued updates. This is sufficient for the controlled update setting considered here. A delayed report may place an earlier event in a later session, and contradictory values can occur within one session. Preferences may also remain valid simultaneously. Handling these cases requires event-validity times or explicit treatment of conflicting relations beyond the present ordering rule.
blocks.zh: TEM使用源会话命令来指定状态,假设有明确的单值更新. 这足以使本文中考虑的控制更新设置。 延迟的报告可能会将较早的事件放到以后的会话中去,相互矛盾的数值可能在一会话中发生. 优惠也可同时有效。 处理这些案件需要事件有效时间或明确处理目前命令规则以外的冲突关系。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: TEM couples history-preserving fact storage with evidence that makes version status explicit. The update rule operates on complete version groups, and retrieval passes source order and historical labels to the generator. Across four backbones, retaining and labelling versions improved historical information use in state-update tasks with compact fact evidence. Hybrid memory also exceeded session-aware RAG on public multi-session questions at the same evidence budget. Together, the results support managing fact versions throughout storage and answering when information changes across conversations.
blocks.zh: TEM夫妇保留历史的事实存储,证据可以明确版本状态. 更新规则运行在完整的版本组上,检索会将源顺序和历史标签传递给生成器. 在四个主干网中,保留和贴标签版本改进了历史信息在有紧凑事实证据的国家更新工作中的使用。 混合记忆也超过了同一证据预算关于公共多会问题的会话意识RAG. 当信息在对话中发生变化时,结果共同支持在整个存储和回答过程中管理事实版本。
